brief: Positioning has been cut, fear stays elevated (AAII bull-bear spread crashed, NAAIM exposure fell sharply) and volatility has been crushed even as markets find a bid, a combination the note reads as ingredients for a painful upside squeeze, especially with NDX seasonality about to turn supportive. It argues the bearish pivot happened too fast and too late: oil relief, a tech rebound and Monday's "pace the frontier" episode overturned lingering AI capex skepticism, so the crowd is now chasing a move it missed, an overreaction that has left sentiment too pessimistic, per Privorotsky. It notes AAII bears are surging even as the VIX resets sharply lower, without resolving whether both readings can be right. Because vols were hammered post-FOMC and realized volatility stayed low for weeks, the note argues that if the squeeze gets another momentum ignition, playing the direction through options, long gamma, especially in tech, is the cleaner trade than the underlying. It flags that the prior session was the first time the daily straddle notably outperformed as realized volatility jumped.
